label: Double hold (42)
source: Aidan Burns, The Highgate Collection: 2017 expanded PDF printed p. 31 / PDF p. 32; 2014 PDF p. 17
notation: Siteswap 42; five-club one-count zap notation. Ben's repeating right-hand 4 is a crossing single pass; his left-hand 2 is a hold. Anne has a hold in the corresponding cycle.

reviewStatus.visualReview: Compared the Double hold (42) diagram on both edition pages; labels and arrow arrangement agree.
